items.english: "That's right. Though each day tires us and worries us and makes us suffer in one way and another, two years are already past. In a little while, *Bōya* will be walking."

The man looked at the child standing there holding the spoon with nothing to do. At once she called out happily in a loud voice, "*Bōya*," and at the same moment the child gave a loud cry, looking at her mother's face, and banged the spoon on the table, "Uma-uma-uma-uma."
notes: Kept *Bōya* untranslated per bible, though the child was fixed as a girl in p2; kept babble as romanized sound without gloss.

items.english: The father hurriedly put rice into the child's mouth.
After a while they laid down their chopsticks.
"Only a little while longer." The man said firmly, as if to himself.
"Yes, we must work, mustn't we." She said calmly, peacefully. Then, holding the child on her lap, she bared a small nipple and began to nurse.
notes: Kept "peacefully" to hold the Anraka network from p3-p4 into the vision and return.

items.english: "Come, let us clear away. And sleep. Let us get up early tomorrow."
notes: Speaker untagged in Japanese; left untagged in English, though p37 suggests the man.

items.english: After a while the man stood up. When he was about to begin clearing the table, the child had already closed her eyes with her cheek against the breast. All around had grown quiet.
notes: Kept child female per p2; kept "quiet" to hold the quiet network.

items.english: "A storm." The man whispered, standing still.
notes: Kept bare and alike to p1 per reading: the storm as barometer, not tableau.

data.say: Drafted p28 to p38, grouping p29-p31 as one English paragraph for the unbroken speech-action chain.
